This is a big improvement — it really captures what I was after. The automatic page details, the read-later queue with those sensible defaults (starting unread, and not marking things read just because I opened them), archiving as its own reversible thing separate from deleting, the smarter search with tags and quotes and and/or/not and grouping, selecting a bunch at once to act on them, the formatted notes, the saved searches, and moving bookmarks in and out — all of that matches how I pictured using it. The defaults you called out sound right to me.

One thing I noticed you've set aside that I'd actually like included: keeping my own readable copy of a saved page. Pages I save sometimes go away, get paywalled, or change later, and I'd hate to lose the thing I saved a link for. So when I save a bookmark, I'd want the app to also keep a copy of that page as it looked, so I can still read it even if the original disappears. And in the case where the link points at a PDF rather than a normal web page, I'd expect it to just keep the PDF itself rather than a copy of a webpage.

Could you fold that in? Once that's in the spec I think we're good to move on to planning.
